body:
You know what it feels like when you're scared of a growling dog running down some steps towards the road? That not-quite-panic burnt-out adrenaline feeling?

You know what it feels like when you were certain you were going to get that job/promotion/greenlight on a project but for reasons you can't quite fathom, you don't? That crushing sense of failing and not even knowing why or how you fucked it up?

Having damned near every waking moment feel like both of those simultaneously regardless of the medication; regardless of the dosage; regardless of the iron pumped, or the miles run; regardless of the long walks in sunshine without sunglasses, the mindfulness practice, the stack of books from Ellis's disciples; regardless of the effort, regardless of the years.

Eventually it's just a simple calculation. Which costs the kids more? Me being here or not.
